notes: CANDIDATE model-aware v2 rule pack for human pre-sales review only. Derived mechanically from honeywell-candidate-rules (v0.1.0-candidate) per docs/config-expansion/RULE_MODEL_GAP_REPORT.md. No rule is active until approved; this pack activates nothing and approves nothing. It re-expresses the configuration LOGIC behind the Honeywell quote instead of freezing quote quantities: wireless license quantities are modeled as the related CW9178I-CFG access-point total (quantityModel same_as_related_sku_total), power cable quantities follow the selected AC power-supply count (quantityModel selected_option_count), 3Y subscription/support terms are modeled as term option groups with a 3Y default and 5Y/7Y review alternatives (no 5Y/7Y SKUs are invented), and historical-to-current replacements are kept as separate replacementCandidates. Legacy quantityRule/quantityValue fields are retained only as Honeywell quote-observed compatibility data and are NOT reusable logic. Prices, discounts, and selling values are NOT rule authority and are intentionally omitted; pricing comes from the catalog/SAR price source at runtime per the MVP pricing contract. The advanced model fields (quantityModel, duplicatePolicy, optionGroups, termOptionGroups, evidenceScope, replacementCandidates) are TYPE-CONTRACT-ONLY forward fields: no runtime evaluator reads them yet. All parent rules, child lines, and replacement candidates remain approved:false and approvalRequired:true.
